title: $:/config/HUWikiPluginLibrary
caption: HUWiki Plugin Library
text:
<$list filter="[{$:/language}else[$:/languages/en-GB]prefix[$:/languages/da]]" variable="forgeLocale">
Dette bibliotek henter installerbare plugins og temaer direkte fra HUWiki Forge på GitHub Pages.

- Åbn biblioteket med TiddlyWikis eksisterende //Get More Plugins//-funktion.
- Pakker installeres i din egen wiki og gemmes med TiddlyWikis normale Gem-funktion.
- Der er ingen upload, konto eller Google-tjeneste bag biblioteket.

[[Se kildekoden på GitHub|https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/tree/main/plugins]]
</$list>

<$list filter="[{$:/language}else[$:/languages/en-GB]!prefix[$:/languages/da]]" variable="forgeLocale">
Browse installable plugins and themes from HUWiki Forge on GitHub Pages.

- Use TiddlyWiki's existing //Get More Plugins// control.
- Packages are installed into your own wiki and saved with TiddlyWiki's native Save action.
- No upload server, account or Google service is required.

[[Browse the GitHub source|https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/tree/main/plugins]]
</$list>

title: $:/config/HUWikiCommunity
caption: HUWiki Community
text:
<$list filter="[{$:/language}else[$:/languages/en-GB]prefix[$:/languages/da]]" variable="forgeLocale">
! HUWiki Community

Her finder du de offentlige HUWiki Forge Editions, som kan bygges og downloades direkte fra GitHub.

[[Åbn HUWiki Community|https://forge.måns.dk/community/]]

En Edition er en selvstændig wiki-skabelon. Den er ikke en uploadt brugerwiki. Offentlige wiki-links kan senere føjes til kataloget efter ejerens tilladelse.

Tailscale Funnel kan bruges til at dele en levende wiki separat, men er ikke nødvendig for at hente Editions.
</$list>

<$list filter="[{$:/language}else[$:/languages/en-GB]!prefix[$:/languages/da]]" variable="forgeLocale">
! HUWiki Community

Discover public HUWiki Forge Editions that you can build and download from GitHub.

[[Open HUWiki Community|https://forge.måns.dk/community/]]

An Edition is a standalone wiki template, not a user-uploaded wiki. Public wiki links can be curated later with their owners' permission.

Tailscale Funnel is an optional way to share a running wiki, not a requirement for downloading Editions.
</$list>
